en.title: League Cup: Manchester City crushes Norwich 5-0
en.summary: Manchester City, the defending champion, defeated Norwich City 5-0 in the English League Cup using a reserve team lineup.

en.title: Strawberry Farm
en.summary: A strawberry farm offers visitors the opportunity to pick their own strawberries and interact with farm animals including ducks, geese, and parrots in a natural setting.

stories.title: مقتل 48 شخصاً على الأقل في نيجيريا بعد تناول مشروب يُشتبه بتلوّثه بالميثانول

en.title: At least 48 dead in Nigeria after consuming drink suspected of methanol contamination
en.summary: At least 48 people died and around 100 others are receiving medical treatment in southern Nigeria after consuming locally-made alcoholic beverages suspected to contain methanol.

stories.title: Arab states and EU express solidarity with Saudi Arabia after deadly Houthi attack

en.title: Arab states and EU express solidarity with Saudi Arabia after deadly Houthi attack
en.summary: Arab states and the European Union expressed support for Saudi Arabia following a Houthi drone attack that killed one person in Taif and injured two others, with Saudi defenses intercepting another drone headed toward Makkah.

stories.title: Israel finalizes tenders for 3,401 units in settlement near Jerusalem

en.title: Israel finalizes tenders for 3,401 units in settlement near Jerusalem
en.summary: Israeli authorities have finalized tenders for over 3,400 settlement units in the E1 project near Jerusalem. International officials have warned that such settlement expansion could undermine efforts to establish a viable Palestinian state.

stories.title: 48 وفاة و182 حالة.. مشروب مشتبه بتلوثه بالميثانول يثير أزمة في نيجيريا

en.title: 48 deaths and 182 cases linked to beverage suspected of methanol contamination in Nigeria
en.summary: A local alcoholic beverage suspected of methanol contamination has caused 48 deaths and 182 cases of illness in Nigeria's Ondo State. Health and security authorities are investigating the source of the contamination.

stories.title: Civil Defense: One Killed, Two Injured by Intercepted Houthi Drone Debris in Taif

en.title: Civil Defense: One Killed, Two Injured by Intercepted Houthi Drone Debris in Taif
en.summary: One person was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Taif.

stories.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif

en.title: Civil Defense: One killed, two injured as Houthi drone intercepted in Taif
en.summary: A Yemeni resident was killed and two others injured when debris from an intercepted Houthi drone fell in Saudi Arabia's Taif, also causing material damage to buildings and vehicles.

stories.title: Israel Adds Tender for 2,167 Housing Units to Settlement Expansion Plan

en.title: Israel Adds Tender for 2,167 Housing Units to Settlement Expansion Plan
en.summary: Israeli authorities have announced a tender for approximately 2,167 additional housing units as part of an ongoing settlement expansion initiative.

stories.title: UK affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its right to defend sovereignty

en.title: UK affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its right to defend sovereignty
en.summary: The United Kingdom has publicly supported Saudi Arabia's right to defend itself and held the Houthi militia responsible for escalating attacks that have injured civilians and disrupted regional shipping.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia cracks down on unlicensed recruitment services with fines up to SR250,000

en.title: Saudi Arabia cracks down on unlicensed recruitment services with fines up to SR250,000
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development identified 10 unlicensed establishments providing recruitment and labor services during inspection campaigns. The violations involved sole proprietorships, service offices, and online platforms operating without proper authorization.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a Houthi drone attack on Makkah and stated it reserves the right to take necessary defensive measures to protect the Two Holy Mosques and their pilgrims.

stories.title: ‎Red Sea Global, Sulaiman Al Habib open Red Sea Hospital

en.title: Red Sea Global, Sulaiman Al Habib open Red Sea Hospital
en.summary: Red Sea Global and Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Services Group opened Red Sea Hospital at The Red Sea destination on September 17. The hospital will provide healthcare services to employees, residents, guests, and local communities under a strategic partnership.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia issues 268 industrial licenses in May worth SAR 2.2B

en.title: Saudi Arabia issues 268 industrial licenses in May worth SAR 2.2B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources granted 268 industrial licenses in May valued at SAR 2.23 billion. These projects are projected to create over 2,484 jobs, while 149 factories began production with SAR 1.43 billion in investments.

stories.title: ‎KEC to launch Knowledge Gardens fund within 6 months: CIO

en.title: KEC to launch Knowledge Gardens fund within 6 months: CIO
en.summary: Knowledge Economic City's Chief Investment Officer stated that procedures to establish an investment fund for the Knowledge Gardens project should be completed within six months. The company is finalizing agreements and project structure with fund managers.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Printing shareholders to vote on 89.4% capital cut on Oct. 26

en.title: Saudi Printing shareholders to vote on 89.4% capital cut on Oct. 26
en.summary: Saudi Printing and Packaging Co. will hold a shareholder vote to reduce its capital from SAR 652.07 million to SAR 68.97 million, eliminating SAR 583.10 million in accumulated losses through the restructuring.

stories.title: ‎Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe

en.title: Lucid, Bolt partner to deploy autonomous mobility services across Europe
en.summary: Lucid Group and Bolt announced a partnership to develop and deploy autonomous vehicles across Europe, with Bolt planning to operate at least 25,000 fully autonomous vehicles by 2035.
